items.explanation: This for discourse reference to prior idea.

items.en: The former is cheaper; the latter is better.
items.cz: První je levnější; druhé je lepší.
items.gap: The former is cheaper; the ____ is better.
accepts: The former is cheaper; the latter is better.

items.en: Such policies rarely work in practice.
items.cz: Takové politiky v praxi zřídka fungují.
accepts: Such policies rarely work in practice.

items.en: As for funding, the picture is mixed.
items.cz: Pokud jde o finance, obraz je smíšený.
items.gap: As ____ funding, the picture is mixed.
accepts: As for funding, the picture is mixed.

items.en: The point is that reform takes time.
items.cz: Jde o to, že reforma trvá.
items.gap: The point ____ that reform takes time.
accepts: The point is that reform takes time.
items.explanation: The point is that… discourse frame.

items.en: That said, progress has been made.
accepts: That said, progress has been made.

items.en: In this respect, the two studies differ.
items.cz: V tomto ohledu se studie liší.
items.gap: In this ____, the two studies differ.
accepts: In this respect, the two studies differ.

items.en: Turning to costs, the outlook is poor.
items.cz: Pokud jde o náklady, výhled je špatný.
items.gap: ____ to costs, the outlook is poor.
accepts: Turning to costs, the outlook is poor.

items.en: The same applies to small firms.
accepts: The same applies to small firms.
